_doc: Single source of truth for MHAD imagery generated with Grok Imagine (image_gen). tool/art/generate_art.py reads this; lib/ui/theme/app_art.dart mirrors the ids (a unit test keeps them in sync). The user picked style D (natural-light photography) from the 2026-11-16 style board, so every subject below is a real, photographable scene. Images never contain readable text, so they work in every locale.
palette: deep navy (#1E3A8A), soft teal (#2A9D8F), sage green (#8FB39A), warm apricot (#F2A65A) and cream (#FAF6EE)

styles.A: Modern editorial flat illustration: clean vector shapes with a subtle paper-grain texture and soft gradients, gentle rounded forms, generous negative space, calm and hopeful mood, muted color palette of {palette}
styles.B: Soft 3D clay-style illustration: rounded matte clay forms, gentle studio lighting with soft shadows, calm and friendly mood, muted color palette of {palette}
styles.C: Hand-painted gouache illustration: visible soft brush texture, warm natural light, gentle storybook feel, calm and hopeful mood, muted color palette of {palette}
styles.D: Natural-light lifestyle photograph: soft window light, shallow depth of field, warm muted color grade, calm and hopeful mood, gentle color accents of {palette}

rules: Photorealistic, candid and natural, like a professional editorial photo. No text, letters, numbers, logos, signage, signatures or watermarks anywhere; any paper, card or screen shows only blank space or soft, out-of-focus lines that cannot be read. Show any people EXACTLY as described (ethnicity, age and gender), as adults with relaxed, natural expressions in dignified, everyday modern clothing (no stereotyped costume or props), often in profile, looking down at what they are doing, or partly turned away; natural hands. No distress, crying, hospital beds, needles, syringes, restraints or loose pills. Full-bleed frame with the main subject well inside the frame so it can be cropped.
